answer: Time-locked vesting blunts Sybil farms: every reward an agent earns lands in a grove of escrowed tranches that unlock over 30 days, and each tranche is clawed back if later audits flag the work as duplicated or colluding. A fresh identity thus yields no spendable pulse of income for a month, so an attacker running 1,000 fakes must fund and maintain all of them through the lock while risking total forfeiture. Even a polished sonnet of copied answers earns nothing liquid before it is checked.
